title: Japanese Kushiyaki Chicken Skewers
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Japanese-inspired dish featuring marinated chicken, aromatic vegetables, and a sweet soy sauce glaze.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and ginger to make the marinade.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the marinated chicken, green onions, bell peppers, onions, and aromatic onto kushiyaki skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Brush with additional soy sauce during the last 2 minutes of grilling, if desired.
